name: 工作区笔记
description: 列出、搜索、读取和写入工作区里的 Markdown 笔记。演示：文件系统权限 + 工具 + 配置。
author: Plugin Harness Team

tools.name: list
tools.description: List all notes in the workspace notes folder with size and last-modified time.
patterns: ^(列出|查看|显示)?(所有|全部)?笔记(列表)?$

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across notes. Returns matching lines with file names and line numbers.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the full content of one note by file name (e.g. welcome.md).

name.description: Note file name, relative to the notes folder

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create a note (or overwrite one, if the allowOverwrite setting is on). Use .md file names.
examples: 新建笔记 todo.md：明天把插件文档写完

notesDir.title: 笔记目录（相对工作区）
notesDir.description: 只能在工作区内；写入权限仅覆盖 notes/，改到别处时写入会被沙箱拒绝
